title: Human-depleted CSF metagenomic reads in MMseqs2 pathogen tutorial
kind: study observations; tutorial-distributed processed sequence subset
study_ids: Piantadosi et al. 2018 Powassan virus encephalitis case; exact public study accession unresolved
provenance: Tutorial reports metagenomic sequencing of patient CSF on hospital day 8, 14 million short nucleotide reads returned; authors removed human reads using Kraken and released 226,908 reads on SRA. It notes some paired-end reads may have been merged with FLASH and supplies mystery_reads.fasta. The relationship between that downloadable file and exact SRA records is not resolved from inspected material.

biological_context.experimental_units: Patient CSF specimen; the tutorial narrative describes one case. It also mentions separate negative controls and patient plasma/blood in a follow-up, but those are not the tutorial FASTA input.
biological_context.assay: Metagenomic sequencing; platform/library details not inspected.
biological_context.design: Clinical pathogen investigation; reads human-depleted by Kraken before tutorial analysis. No complete experimental design inspected.

metadata.read_count_original: 14 million short nucleotide reads per tutorial
metadata.processing: human reads removed using Kraken; possible paired-read merging using FLASH, tutorial wording is not precise about which reads were merged

assets.processing_stage: tutorial input, described as prepared reads after human read removal
assets.relationship: Tutorial asset; exact mapping to the mentioned SRA release and any pair merging remains unverified.

assets.format: SRA records, exact accession not identified
assets.processing_stage: public archive location cited for reduced reads
assets.relationship: Tutorial says a smaller 226,908-read set was released on SRA; specific accession unavailable in inspected evidence.

access_and_terms.reuse: No license or reuse terms inspected.

inspection: Read the MMseqs2 Tutorials wiki page (retrieved 2026-09-30, mutable/unpinned), sections The Patient, The Dataset, Assigning taxonomic labels, and the follow-up sections. Did not download FASTA/SRA files or inspect bases/metadata.
limitations: No exact BioProject/SRA accession, sample metadata, read-pair status or FASTA checksum identified.

title: Saccharomyces cerevisiae contig segment NC_001133.9_100425_153163.fa

Tutorial's example output identifies the contig as S. cerevisiae chromosome/accession context by taxonomy assignment to taxid 4932; source asset itself was not previewed. The adjacent `sacc_prots_in_segment.fa` is explicitly optional and unused, so not included as an input dataset here.
